## 1. A request that you focus on doing your reviews of your assigned peer's submissions

- Your other peers are depending upon you to do your reviews so that they don't
  have to review everyone. If you don't do it, or just rubber-stamp it, then
  they have less confidence in the whole process, some orgs may get by without
  any review.

## 2. A reminder that we need that review by Monday afternoon at the absolute latest

- The org you're reviewing deserves time to respond to your questions with real
  information.
- All your peers deserve time to read all the questions and responses from all
  the orgs and offer their own opinions and/or questions.
- Everyone deserves time to arrive at (rough) consensus on whether a flaw is
  small enough that a controlled rerun can cure the flaw, and exactly what
  should be changed to get that rerun.
- Everyone deserves time to arrive at (rough) consensus on whether a flaw is too
  big (it would be unfair to allow a rerun) and that that row needs to be
  rejected.

## 3. A request that you try to update THIS issue with your progress on your review each day until Tuesday the 4th

- I will need a public acknowledgement that:
  - you did your assigned reviews (at least),
  - how many (if any) questions you asked of the org being reviewed, and
  - whether you found any flaws that the rest of us need to be aware of.
